metadata.title: Conformally flat free boundary minimal hypersurfaces in the ball
metadata.abstract: In this note, we show that a locally conformally flat free boundary minimal hypersurface in $B^n$ must be either an equatorial ball or a critical catenoid for all $n \geq 4$. As a consequence, we conclude that the equatorial ball is unique among locally conformally flat free boundary minimal hypersurfaces in $B^n$ with the topology of $B^{n - 1}$.
